inventory_count_items_counted_check.name: inventory_count_items_counted_check
inventory_count_items_counted_check.value: ("inventory_count_items"."counted" and "inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" is not null) or (not "inventory_count_items"."counted" and "inventory_count_items"."closing_quantity" is null)

inventory_counts_status_check.name: inventory_counts_status_check
inventory_counts_status_check.value: ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'draft' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'submitted' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("inventory_counts"."status" = 'reviewed' and "inventory_counts"."submitted_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."submitted_at" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_by" is not null and "inventory_counts"."reviewed_at" is not null)

inventory_days_status_check.name: inventory_days_status_check
inventory_days_status_check.value: ("inventory_days"."status" = 'open' and "inventory_days"."closed_by" is null and "inventory_days"."closed_at" is null) or ("inventory_days"."status" = 'closed' and "inventory_days"."closed_by" is not null and "inventory_days"."closed_at" is not null)

replenishment_request_items_quantities_c.name: replenishment_request_items_quantities_check
replenishment_request_items_quantities_c.value: "replenishment_request_items"."suggested_quantity" >= 0 and "replenishment_request_items"."requested_quantity" > 0 and ("replenishment_request_items"."approved_quantity" is null or "replenishment_request_items"."approved_quantity" >= 0) and "replenishment_request_items"."fulfilled_quantity" >= 0
